_readme: Add products to the array below and they appear at /shop/ with a page each at /shop/<slug>/. Every field except name is optional. See README.md for the full field list. While the array is empty the /shop/ hub stays noindex so an empty page is never submitted to Google; it becomes indexable automatically once a product is added.
affiliateDisclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you buy through one we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. It does not change what we list or how we describe it.

categories.name: E-Bikes
categories.description: Complete electric bikes worth owning if you ride in Florida often enough that renting stops making sense - cruisers, step-throughs and fat-tyre bikes built for sand and salt air.

categories.name: E-Scooters
categories.description: Standing electric scooters for short beach-town hops and last-mile riding, where a full-size bike is more machine than the trip needs.

categories.name: E-Skateboards
categories.description: Electric skateboards and longboards for smooth promenades and paved trails, plus what to know before riding one on a Florida shared-use path.
